title: Hispanic students made up 32% of Seminole County schools enrollment in 2023-24 school year
text:
Manny Diaz,Jr., Commissioner of education at Florida Department of Education | https://www.fldoe.org/about-us/commissioner.stml
Manny Diaz,Jr., Commissioner of education at Florida Department of Education | https://www.fldoe.org/about-us/commissioner.stml
Florida Department of Education.
Data showed that Seminole County welcomed a total of 65,438 students during the 2023-24 school year. Among them, Hispanic students comprised 32% of the student body to be the second most represented ethnicity in the county.
Among the 74 schools in Seminole County, Seminole High School recorded the highest enrollment of Hispanic students in the 2023-24 school year, with a total of 1,044 students, making up 26.6% of the school's total student body.
Gov. DeSantis has approved an education budget of over $28 billion for the 2024-25 school year. The new budget includes more than $1 billion earmarked exclusively for teacher salaries to better address the teacher shortage the state faces.
A 2024 WalletHub study ranked Florida 49th in the nation for teacher salaries when adjusted for cost of living, making it one of the lowest in the U.S.
